reasoning: Counterexample: p = 11 is prime, but 2^11 - 1 = 2048 - 1 = 2047, and 23 * 89 = 2047 (23*89 = 23*90 - 23 = 2070 - 23 = 2047). So 2^11 - 1 is composite, refuting the claim. (Small primes p = 2, 3, 5, 7 give 3, 7, 31, 127, all prime, but the pattern fails at p = 11.)
